theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: US Energy Complex is eligible, not crowded (z=0.53), and has a mid durability_bar (0.54) with mixed hurst, but it is one of the few non-crowded eligible uptrend themes. The Energy Equal-Weight variant is also eligible and even less crowded (z=0.10), suggesting the energy move is not reflexively extended. The trend-gate leg supports a stay-aligned lean as long as energy holds above its own trend, though mixed hurst means follow-through is not strongly trend-like.
theses.dissent: Mixed hurst_tag and modest durability (0.54) with narrow breadth (0.318) suggest the energy move may be a small, unstable subset of names rather than a broad complex advance, vulnerable to an oil-price reversal.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage

This is not a fade call, only an avoid until it re-clears the trend gate.
